notes.title: v1.2.0
notes.content:
- Added a tutorial page to experiment with how the gravestone stop the spawn counter.
- Fixed a bug where buttons on the title screen sometimes didn't respond.
- Corrected minor typos.

notes.title: Merge Coin: Mai is Now Released!
notes.content: [p]It may look simple, but Merge Coin: Mai delivers a [i]heavy challenge[/i] and [i]deep strategic gameplay[/i]. A hardcore, classic-style experience with an eerie and atmospheric SE—creating a surreal game world that's already become a hot topic (between the developer and his wife)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674582/65d0e9989f5bf61b85f58d723eec2be2be27ce49.png"][/img][/p][p]We're celebrating the launch with 40%! Compete for high scores with your friends and family in the global rankings![/p]

notes.title: Merge Coin: Mai launches July 11!
notes.content:
[p]The Steam store page for Merge Coin: Mai is now live! Yey![/p][p]Seeing Merge Coin: Mai displayed on the familiar Steam page feels kind of strange.[/p][p]It's a bit like being on TV. 
[/p][p]We’re planning to release the game on July 11.[/p][p]A free demo is also under consideration, so please wishlist the game to stay updated![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674582/62bd9c3165a62df58a0261d3135a819665ebd46d.png"][/img][/p]
